verdict.rationale: Twilio is documented as API-first with a very broad surface: over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products, usable over HTTPS or SDKs. Account-level and administrative tasks are also exposed via API, including buying and porting numbers, regulatory bundles, and default call-recording settings, and community users praise the API's ease of use. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of UI/API parity, confirmation that Console-oriented flows such as toll-free verification and no-code portability checks have API equivalents, and independent hands-on verification of parity.
